name: @mashbean/pocket-reply
description: Pocket Reply (口袋回覆): close the loop on an audience question pool — one talk arc, a personal reply for every questioner, a public receipt — on a single Cloudflare Worker with Durable Objects and Workers AI. Uncommon Ground's method, no scripts to run, one-click deploy

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run deploy:dry && npm run deploy:dry:production

LOOP.description: One SQLite Durable Object per question pool: questions, beats, arc, takes, replies and the receipt.

COORDINATOR.description: Durable Object holding the deployment-wide daily Workers AI neuron ledger and the creation rate limit.

AI.description: Workers AI binding (Gemma 4) used for clustering, the arc, takes and replies.
